lines.en: label utaarchery1:
scene utadownbad1
: Sensei? When did you get here?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你什么时候来的？

lines.en: : Somewhere around when you started holding hands with Wakana. I left though since I figured you two probably wanted to be alone.
lines.zh: : 大概是你开始牵 Wakana 手的时候吧。不过我后来就走了，想着你们俩大概想单独待着。

lines.en: scene utadownbad2
: Ah...Yeah, I don’t really know how Osako-chan would feel about me stealin’ her girlfriend out from underneath her.
lines.zh: : 啊……是啊，我也不太清楚 Osako 酱会怎么想我从她眼皮底下把她女朋友抢走。

lines.en: : I’m honestly surprised she even kept that job. I figured it was just a temporary thing while the dojo was stuck in limbo.
lines.zh: : 说实话我挺惊讶她居然还留着那份工作。我本来以为那只是道场悬而未决时的临时活儿。

lines.en: scene utadownbad3
: Gotta make that money somehow, Sensei. Osako-chan’s gotten a taste of that sweet nectar and ain’t ever looking back.
lines.zh: : 总得想办法赚钱啊，Sensei。Osako 酱尝到了那甜美花蜜的滋味，就再也回不了头了。

lines.en: : Don’t talk about Osako tasting nectar anywhere near Wakana. She’s already worried I’m going to steal her woman.
lines.zh: : 别在 Wakana 附近说 Osako 尝花蜜的事。她已经在担心我会把她女人抢走了。

lines.en: : I can hear you, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 我听得见哦，Arakawa。

lines.en: : See? She’s terrified.
lines.zh: : 看吧？她吓坏了。

lines.en: scene utadownbad4
: Are you done being an archer now? Can we go back to being friends?
lines.zh: : 你弓道练完了吗？我们能做回朋友了吗？

lines.en: : Do we always stop being friends whenever I do something for myself?
lines.zh: : 每当我为自己做点什么，我们就不再是朋友了吗？

lines.en: : Uta, I have extreme social anxiety. We stop being friends whenever I can’t see you.
lines.zh: : Uta，我有严重的社交焦虑。只要我看不见你，我们就不是朋友了。

lines.en: : Io, the fact that you function at all is something I think we should be proud of.
lines.zh: : Io，你能正常运转这件事本身，我就觉得值得骄傲了。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I’d call what I do “functioning,” but I am in an extremely good mood right now, so...what the heck. Sure. Let’s all be proud of me for a minute.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我这样算不算「运转」，不过我现在心情好得不得了，所以……管他呢。行吧。那就为我骄傲一分钟。

lines.en: : Just a minute, though. Any longer than that and I will actually die.
lines.zh: : 就一分钟哦。再久一点我就真的会死。

lines.en: scene utadownbad5
: You?...In a good mood?...
: You and Sensei weren’t playing tonsil hockey behind the storage building, were you?
lines.zh: : 你和 Sensei 该不会在仓库后面打舌吻吧？

lines.en: : Even better. He was opening up to me.
lines.zh: : 比那更好。他在向我敞开心扉。

lines.en: : I said literally one thing.
lines.zh: : 他就说了一句话而已。

lines.en: scene utadownbad6
: Hah...it’s like the leaderboard of this harem changes every time I close my eyes.
lines.zh: : 哈……我每次一闭眼，这个后宫的排行榜就变一次。

lines.en: : Gonna have to break out my notebook when we get back home and see which spot you’re in now, Io.
lines.zh: : 等回家我得掏出我的小本本，看看你现在排到第几了，Io。

lines.en: : You don’t actually have a harem leaderboard, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会真有个后宫排行榜吧？

lines.en: scene utadownbad7
: Well, what else am I gonna do in class? You don’t make me study anymore.
lines.zh: : 不然我上课还能干嘛？你都不让我学习了。

lines.en: : I’m like four pages of harem notes away from starting a whole betting ring, Sensei. Do you have any idea how much money there is to be made off of this?
lines.zh: : Sensei，我差不多再写满四页后宫笔记，就能开一整个赌局了。你知道这上头能赚多少钱吗？

lines.en: : Am I just a toy to you?
lines.zh: : 对你来说我只是个玩具吗？

lines.en: scene utadownbad8
: No. But you {i}are{/i} a toy to Uta-chan. And I can swap personas any time I like, Master.
lines.zh: : 不是。但对你来说，Uta 酱{i}才是{/i}玩具。而且我随时都能切换人格哦，Master。

lines.en: : Marry me.
lines.zh: : 嫁给我吧。

lines.en: scene utadownbad9
: What do you think you’re doing, Sensei? Proposing to someone in the bottom ten when you’ve got a higher ranked girl right next to you?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你以为你在干什么？身边就站着排名更高的女孩，你居然向一个排在十名开外的人求婚？

lines.en: : In his defense, I am definitely not marriage material. In fact, I think even the concept of marriage is archaic and stupid. Why should we have to sign a sheet of paper to prove that we-
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我绝对不是适合结婚的人。事实上，我觉得婚姻这个概念本身就又过时又愚蠢。我们凭什么非得签一张纸来证明我们——

lines.en: scene utadownbad10
: Shush.
: Okay.
lines.zh: : 好的。

lines.en: : Can I ask who number one in your...weird ranking thing is?
lines.zh: : 我能问问你那个……奇怪的排名里第一名是谁吗？

lines.en: scene utadownbad11
: I mean...you {i}can.{/i} I’m just not sure if you want to know the answer.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你{i}可以{/i}问。只是我不确定你想不想知道答案。

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t I want to know the answer?
lines.zh: : 我为什么会不想知道答案？

lines.en: : Cause it’s Ami.
lines.zh: : 因为第一名是 Ami。

lines.en: : See? Even Io’s disappointed in you and she’s your number one fan.
lines.zh: : 看吧？连 Io 都对你失望了，她可是你的头号粉丝。

lines.en: : First off, no one should be disappointed in me when this ranking clearly has nothing to do with-
lines.zh: : 首先，谁都不该对我失望，因为这个排名显然跟——

lines.en: : Ah-ah-ah. Before you go saying “this ranking has nothing to do with how I treat girls and is based on how much they love me,” it {i}absolutely{/i} has {i}everything{/i} to do with how you treat us.
lines.zh: : 啊-啊-啊。在你开口说「这个排名跟你怎么对待女孩无关、是按她们有多爱你排的」之前，它{i}百分百{/i}跟你如何对待我们有关。

lines.en: : Ami gets more special treatment than anybody.
lines.zh: : Ami 得到的特殊待遇比谁都多。

lines.en: : Combine that with the fact that she’s also one of the most vocal about her love for you {i}and{/i} how you guys go way, way back and you’ve got a combined Uta-chan certified compatibility score of...9.7/10.
lines.zh: : 再加上她也是把爱意挂在嘴边最响亮的之一，{i}而且{/i}你们俩渊源久得很——综合下来，Uta 酱认证的契合度评分是……9.7/10。

lines.en: : That is way too high of a score for my compatibility with my {i}niece.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我和我{i}侄女{/i}的契合度，这分数高得太离谱了。

lines.en: scene utadownbad12
: Love comes in all kinds of forms, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 爱有各种各样的形式啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : Is that why you had a crush on a sponge?
lines.zh: : 所以你才会暗恋一块海绵？

lines.en: scene utadownbad13
: Don’t bring the sponge into this! That was basically a zillion years ago! My tastes have changed since then! I like humans now!
lines.zh: : 别把海绵扯进来！那都是几亿年前的事了！我的品味早就变了！我现在喜欢人类了！

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Great! Now Io knows about the sponge! Look what you did!
lines.zh: : 好极了！现在 Io 也知道海绵的事了！看看你干的好事！

lines.en: : I thought Io already knew about the sponge.
lines.zh: : 我以为 Io 早就知道海绵的事了。

lines.en: : I feel like I know less and less every time you say “sponge.”
lines.zh: : 你每说一次「海绵」，我就觉得自己知道得更少了。

lines.en: scene utadownbad14
: Io! Wakana says you have to come help me clean up the storage room since you sat around all day being worthless.
lines.zh: : Io！Wakana 说你得来帮我打扫储藏室，因为你一整天坐在这儿，一点用都没有。

lines.en: : What? Since when is that a thing I get punished for?
lines.zh: : 什么？这种事什么时候也成了罚我的理由？

lines.en: : Kanda-san, if you call me “Wakana” one more time, I will see to it that you’re removed from this club and sent off to practice kyudo in the sinkhole.
lines.zh: : Kanda 同学，你要是再叫我一次「Wakana」，我就保证让你被踢出这个社团、发配到天坑里去练弓道。

lines.en: : I think this is your chance, Io.
lines.zh: : Io，我觉得这是你的机会。

lines.en: scene utadownbad15
: But I want to keep hanging out with you and Uta. My day finally became bearable.
lines.zh: : 可我还想继续跟你和 Uta 待着。我今天终于变得能忍受了。

lines.en: : We’ll be here when you get back, Io. I ain’t doing anything today. Sensei and I will just hang out and...
lines.zh: : 你回来的时候我们还在这儿，Io。我今天什么也不干。Sensei 和我就是一起待着，然后……

lines.en: : And I guess that’s it. We’ll just hang out.
lines.zh: : 然后大概就这样了。我们就是一起待着。

lines.en: : Greenie! Hurry the fuck up! I have shit to do after this!
lines.zh: : 小绿！赶紧他妈的过来！这事完了之后我还有别的事要干！

lines.en: scene utadownbad16
: Stop calling me that, you incorrigible bimbo! I have a name!
lines.zh: : 别那么叫我，你这个不可救药的蠢货！我有名字！

lines.en: : Yeah but you throw a hissy fit whenever I use that as well. Just get over here and help me clean already.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我用那个名字叫你，你也要闹脾气。少废话，快过来帮忙打扫。

lines.en: : Fine. But if you expect me to talk to you while we’re in there, I’m walking right back out.
lines.zh: : 行。但你要是指望我在里面跟你说话，我立马转身就走。

lines.en: scene utadownbad17
: I’ll be back, I guess...
lines.zh: : 我马上回来，大概吧……

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah. Have fun.
lines.zh: : 呃……好。玩得开心。

lines.en: Io wanders off to join Kirin in the shed and, despite my suggestion that she try and befriend her just a short while ago, I have a creeping feeling that that won’t be happening today.
lines.zh: Io 晃悠着去工具房找 Kirin 了，尽管不久前我才建议她试着和 Kirin 交个朋友，我却有种预感，这事今天成不了。

lines.en: On the bright side, though...she {i}did{/i} agree to contributing in some way, which is more than I’d typically expect from her.
lines.zh: 不过往好的方面想……她{i}确实{/i}答应了要以某种方式参与，这已经比我平时对她的期望高了。

lines.en: Who knows? Maybe she really {i}is{/i} so desperate to please me that she’s going to actually start taking a few steps forward?
lines.zh: 谁知道呢？也许她{i}真的{/i}这么急于讨好我，以至于真会开始往前走几步？

lines.en: Or maybe she’s just trying to somehow increase her place in the unofficial harem ranking.
lines.zh: 或者她只是想方设法提升自己在这份非官方后宫排行榜上的名次。

lines.en: scene utadownbad18
: So, now that you’re alone with Uta-chan (Archer form), what do you wanna do? You ever use a bow before?
lines.zh: : 那么，现在你跟 Uta 酱（弓道形态）单独相处了，你想干点什么？你以前用过弓吗？

lines.en: : Do I look like the type of guy who has used a bow before?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像用过弓的那种人吗？

lines.en: : No. But you look like the type of guy who’s {i}about{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 不像。但你看起来像{i}马上{/i}就要用的那种人。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene black
: Come on! Take this! I’ll show you how it’s done!
lines.zh: : 来吧！拿着这个！我教你怎么做！

lines.en: : I’m not as good of a teacher as Miss Watabe, but if you’re gonna learn this from anybody else, I’m probably the one you wanna come to!
lines.zh: : 我不像 Watabe 小姐那么会教，不过如果你要跟别人学这个，我大概就是你想找的那个人！

lines.en: Uta hands me the bow (Which I have no idea how to hold properly) before grabbing my waist and redirecting me toward the targets at the far end of the range.
lines.zh: Uta 把弓递给我（我完全不知道该怎么正确地握），然后抓住我的腰，把我转向靶场另一头的靶子。

lines.en: That part I probably could have figured out on my own, but I’m not about to deny any amount of physical contact from Uta-chan.
lines.zh: 那部分我大概自己也能弄明白，不过我可不会拒绝任何一点来自 Uta 酱的身体接触。

lines.en: scene utadownbad19
{i}This{/i} level of physical contact is not what I expected, though.
lines.zh: 但{i}这种{/i}程度的身体接触，倒是我没料到的。

lines.en: Instead of coaching me from the sidelines or nearby like I expected her to, Uta takes her place directly behind me and rests her hands on my arm and my wrist respectively.
lines.zh: 她没有像我以为的那样在旁边或附近指导我，而是直接站到我身后，双手分别搭上我的手臂和手腕。

lines.en: Her chestguard presses up against my back and robs me of a sensation I have longed for, but my imagination does its job and fills in the blanks for me so I don’t miss out entirely.
lines.zh: 她的护胸紧贴着我的后背，夺走了我长久以来渴望的那种触感，不过我的想象力替我填补了空白，让我不至于完全错过。

lines.en: Then, from what feels like miles below, a bright and joyous voice with a mild rasp to it cuts through the air, crawls up my back, and nests in my ears.
lines.zh: 然后，从仿佛几英里之下传来的、带着一丝沙哑的明亮欢快的声音划破空气，爬上我的后背，在我的耳朵里筑了巢。

lines.en: : Don’t pay any attention to me, okay? Just straighten out your limbs and try to stand up straight.
lines.zh: : 别管我，好吗？把四肢伸直，试着站直。

lines.en: : Also, please don’t let go of the string. I don’t want it to snap back and break all of my fingers off.
lines.zh: : 还有，请千万别松开弓弦。我可不想它弹回来，把我的手指全崩断。

lines.en: : You’re sure asking a lot out of a first-timer, huh?
lines.zh: : 你对一个新手的要求还真多啊？

lines.en: : Yeah, but only cause I think you’d be pretty good at this with some practice.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过只是因为我觉得你练练就能很擅长。

lines.en: scene utadownbad20
: Your body’s kinda huge, Sensei. And your figure is great too.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你身子还挺魁梧的。而且体型也很棒。

lines.en: : If a girl my size is able to handle a bow as well as I can, just imagine how the snap will sound when {i}you{/i} launch your arrow.
lines.zh: : 连我这种体型的女孩都能把弓使得这么好，想象一下{i}你{/i}放箭时那声脆响会有多好听。

lines.en: : I’d say we should find out, but I think you said something about wanting to keep your fingers.
lines.zh: : 我也想说我们现在就试试，可你刚才好像说过想保住自己的手指。

lines.en: : That is correct. Updating my harem ranking will be hard if I can’t write anymore.
lines.zh: : 没错。要是写不了字，我要更新后宫排行榜可就难了。

lines.en: : Also, don’t get cocky thinking your shot will echo across the range on the first try. There’s a lot more to kyudo than raw power. That’s only a tiny part of it.
lines.zh: : 还有，别得意忘形地以为你第一次试就能让箭声回荡整个靶场。弓道讲究的可远不止蛮力，那只是其中很小的一部分。

lines.en: : I’m just saying it {i}could{/i} sound beautiful one day. And that you {i}might{/i} be great at this if you keep practicing.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，有一天它{i}可能{/i}会很好听。而且你如果坚持练下去，{i}说不定{/i}会很厉害。

lines.en: : I’m open to practicing as much as you want so long as we can always do it like this.
lines.zh: : 只要每次都能像这样练，我愿意练多少次都行。

lines.en: scene utadownbad21
: What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: scene utadownbad22
: Uta?
lines.zh: : Uta？

lines.en: : We can practice whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 你想练的时候，我们随时都能练。

lines.en: : I get that. But you’re-
lines.zh: : 我知道。可你——

lines.en: : I’m just making sure your posture stays good. You can keep ignoring me.
lines.zh: : 我只是想确保你的姿势不出问题。你可以继续无视我。

lines.en: scene utadownbad23
: I think that might be a little easier said than done.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这事说起来容易做起来难。

lines.en: : I’d say I’m happy to hear that, but that would basically be the same thing as admitting that-
lines.zh: : 我也想说我很高兴听你这么说，但那就基本上等于承认了——

lines.en: : What are you guys doing?
lines.zh: : 你们俩在干什么？

lines.en: scene utadownbad24
: UHH! NOTHING! ARCHERY! POSTURE!
lines.zh: : 呃啊！没什么！弓道！姿势！

lines.en: : JUST...HELPING SENSEI WITH HIS FORM!
lines.zh: : 就……只是帮 Sensei 调整姿势！

lines.en: : Cool, but...why are you yelling?
lines.zh: : 酷，不过……你们干嘛要吼？

lines.en: : Because I’m...in the zone?
lines.zh: : 因为我在……进入状态？

lines.en: : Huh. Well, I’m done for now if you guys want to-
lines.zh: : 嗯。那我这边搞定了，如果你们想——

lines.en: : Actually! Uhh...I have to talk to Sensei about something he just told me!
lines.zh: : 等等！呃……Sensei 刚跟我说了件事，我得跟他谈谈！

lines.en: scene utadownbad25
: You do?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : SHH! She saw me hugging you! Act sad.
lines.zh: : 嘘！她看见我抱着你了！装难过。

lines.en: : But I-
lines.zh: : 可是我——

lines.en: : Sensei! Please!
lines.zh: : Sensei！求你了！

lines.en: scene utadownbad26
: I’m sad and I need Uta’s help for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我很难过，需要 Uta 的帮助，原因不明。

lines.en: : S-See?! The poor guy’s basically in tatters! But give me a few minutes with him and I’ll whip him right back into shape for you, Io!
lines.zh: : 看、看到了吧？！这可怜的家伙基本上已经碎成片了！不过给我几分钟，我保证把他收拾好，完璧归赵地交给你，Io！

lines.en: : For me? Why would that be for me? If Sensei’s actually feeling down, shouldn’t you be doing that for {i}him?{/i}
lines.zh: : 交给我？为什么会是交给我？如果 Sensei 真的心情低落，你不该是为{i}他{/i}才这么做的吗？

lines.en: : That’s...yes! That’s what I meant! But you are also here, so...when I return, you will also reap the benefits of...his happiness!
lines.zh: : 那当然……对！我就是这个意思！不过你也在这儿，所以……等我回来，你也同样能受益于……他的快乐！

lines.en: scene utadownbad27
: You’re acting really weird right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在真的很不对劲。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I feel really...bad for him...because of the sad thing he told me...
lines.zh: : 我真的……为他感到难过……因为他刚告诉我的那件伤心事……

lines.en: : It really is sad.
lines.zh: : 那确实很伤心。

lines.en: : {i}Just start walking away. She’ll wait.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}赶紧走开吧。她会等着。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m going to start walking away now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就要走开了。

lines.en: scene utadownbad28
: We’ll be back in a few minutes, Io! Don’t...go anywhere!
lines.zh: : 我们几分钟后就回来，Io！别……乱跑啊！

lines.en: : I sure hope I don’t stay sad any longer.
lines.zh: : 我真希望自己别再这么难过了。

lines.en: : {i}Give it a break, Sensei! Your acting sucks!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}差不多得了，Sensei！你的演技烂透了！{/i}

lines.en: : What the heck just happened?
lines.zh: : 刚才到底发生了什么？

lines.en: scene black
scene utadownbad29
: (Screaming internally)
lines.zh: : （内心尖叫）

lines.en: : I feel like you could have handled that a little better.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你刚才可以处理得更好一点。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re one to talk with all of that “I’m so sad! Woe is me!” crap! Those acting chops wouldn’t last you one minute in a maid cafe!
lines.zh: : 是啊，你还有脸说，什么「我好难过！我好苦命啊！」那套鬼话！就你这演技，在女仆咖啡厅撑不过一分钟！

lines.en: scene utadownbad30
: Hey, you sucked too. I’m starting to think you get your powers from the uniform.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你也烂透了。我开始怀疑你的能力是从那身制服上来的。

lines.en: : It definitely helps!
lines.zh: : 那确实有帮助！

lines.en: : So, are you going to tell me why you pulled me into this-
lines.zh: : 那么，你要不要告诉我，你为什么把我拉进这——

lines.en: scene utadownbad31
: Wait...where even are we?
lines.zh: : 等等……我们现在到底在哪儿？

lines.en: : The tea ceremony room.
lines.zh: : 茶室。

lines.en: : We have a tea ceremony room?
lines.zh: : 我们有茶室？

lines.en: : We have a whole tea ceremony club. They just happen to use one of the buildings near the archery range since this is where they keep all the...old school stuff, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我们有一整个茶道社。他们只是碰巧用弓道场附近的一栋楼，因为这边放着所有……比较老式的东西吧，我猜。

lines.en: : Okay, but then...why exactly did you pull me into the tea ceremony room?
lines.zh: : 好吧，那……你到底为什么把我拉进茶室？

lines.en: scene utadownbad29
: I have no idea! It just happened!
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道！就这么发生了！

lines.en: : At first, it was probably because I didn’t want Io to think anything suspicious was going on, but now I realize that this just makes everything look even {i}more{/i} suspicious!
lines.zh: : 一开始大概是不想让 Io 觉得有什么可疑的事，可现在我意识到，这样一来反而显得{i}更{/i}可疑了！

lines.en: : Then...should we go back out there?
lines.zh: : 那……我们要不要再出去？

lines.en: : No! Because coming in here for just one minute would make everything even {i}more{/i} suspicious!
lines.zh: : 不行！因为只进来一分钟就出去，一切会显得{i}更{/i}可疑！

lines.en: scene utadownbad32
: You really dug yourself into a hole this time, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 这次你真是把自己挖进坑里了，对吧？

lines.en: : Ahhhh! What am I doing, Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！我到底在干什么啊，Sensei？！

lines.en: : You’re being suspicious as hell, that’s what.
lines.zh: : 你现在的样子可疑得要命，这就是你在干的事。

lines.en: scene utadownbad33
: Or...wait. I think the word is “sus” now. I’ve been hearing the other girls say that lately.
lines.zh: : 或者……等等。我觉得现在大家说的应该是「可疑」了吧。最近我总听其他女孩这么说。

lines.en: : Okay. I need to sit down.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我得坐下来。

lines.en: scene black
Uta takes her shoes off and sits down on the tatami mat, pulling her knees up to her chest and gently rocking back and forth as I lower myself to meet her.
lines.zh: Uta 脱下鞋，在榻榻米上坐下，把膝盖抱到胸前，轻轻地前后摇晃着，而我也跟着蹲下身去与她平视。

lines.en: It’s clear that, for some reason, this spur of the moment decision has already turned into spur of the moment regret, but that doesn’t mean we can’t figure out some way to enjoy it.
lines.zh: 很明显，不知为何，这个一时冲动的决定已经变成了一时冲动的后悔，但这并不代表我们找不到办法好好享受它。

lines.en: Especially since her best friend is probably still standing exactly where we left her and attempting to wrap her head around everything currently going on.
lines.zh: 尤其是她最好的朋友大概还站在我们丢下她的那个地方，正绞尽脑汁地想弄明白眼下发生的一切。

lines.en: But hey, that’s fine. Because I’m doing the exact same thing.
lines.zh: 不过嘛，那也没关系。因为我正在做的，跟她一模一样。

lines.en: scene utadownbad34
Or, at least that’s what I {i}was{/i} doing before finally getting to look at Uta’s face- which is currently redder than I have ever seen it before.
lines.zh: 或者，至少在我终于看清 Uta 的脸{i}之前{/i}是这样——那张脸现在比我见过的任何时候都红。

lines.en: : You just wanted to be alone with me for a little while longer, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你只是想再跟我多单独待一会儿，对吧？

lines.en: : Wh...What makes you think that?
lines.zh: : 什……你凭什么这么想？

lines.en: : The face. The rocking back and forth. The nervous poke war your index fingers are having with one another right now.
lines.zh: : 你的表情。你的前后摇晃。还有你两根食指现在正在互相戳来戳去的样子。

lines.en: : I’m just...really nervous around tea.
lines.zh: : 我只是……在茶面前特别紧张。

lines.en: : You know, you’ve said a lot of questionable things over the brief time I’ve known you, but that one really makes me question just what type of person you are, Uta.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，在我认识你的这短短时间里，你说过不少让人起疑的话，但这一句真的让我开始怀疑你到底是个什么样的人了，Uta。

lines.en: scene utadownbad35
: I’m...not good at thinking things through, okay?! My whole life is a series of weird, impulsive decisions! This is just the first time you’ve gotten wrapped up in one.
lines.zh: : 我……就是不太会想事情，行了吧？！我这一辈子就是一连串奇怪的冲动决定！这只是你第一次被卷进来而已。

lines.en: : There was also the one time in-
lines.zh: : 还有那次在——

lines.en: : The karaoke collision was an accident! Not an impulse!
lines.zh: : 卡拉OK那次撞上是意外！不是冲动！

lines.en: : Was almost kissing me {i}after{/i} the collision an accident too?
lines.zh: : 撞上{i}之后{/i}差点吻我也是意外吗？

lines.en: : Nope! Because that part never happened and it’s all one big fantasy you dreamt up!
lines.zh: : 不是！因为那部分从来就没发生过，全是你自己幻想出来的！

lines.en: : Ahh, okay. Just making sure.
lines.zh: : 啊，好吧。确认一下而已。

lines.en: : For the record, though- I don’t really think being impulsive always has to be a bad thing. I {i}like{/i} being alone with you. Just...probably not when Io is also expecting to be here.
lines.zh: : 不过我要声明一下——我并不觉得冲动就一定是坏事。我{i}喜欢{/i}跟你单独待着。只是……大概不该是 Io 也指望在这儿的时候。

lines.en: scene utadownbad36
: AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
: Uta, chill. It’s really not a big deal.
lines.zh: : Uta，冷静点。真的没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : Io knows all about you, right? Because, if that’s the case, explaining to her that you just impulsively dragged me in here should fix pretty much every misunderstanding you’re worried about.
lines.zh: : Io 对你的一切都很了解，对吧？如果是这样，跟她解释你只是一时冲动把我拽进来，应该就能化解你担心的所有误会。

lines.en: : It’s {i}because{/i} she knows me so well that I’m worried, Sensei! I’m only like this under very specific circumstances!
lines.zh: : 正{i}因为{/i}她太了解我，我才担心啊，Sensei！我只会在非常特定的情况下才变成这样！

lines.en: : And those circumstances are?
lines.zh: : 那是什么样的情况？

lines.en: scene utadownbad37
: Circumstances I must be very careful with.
lines.zh: : 是我必须非常小心的情况。

lines.en: : And why is-
lines.zh: : 那又是为——

lines.en: : Because I don’t want them to get me in trouble.
lines.zh: : 因为我不想让它们给我招来麻烦。

lines.en: : And because I’m...
lines.zh: : 还因为我……

lines.en: scene utadownbad38
: I’m afraid it might happen again...
lines.zh: : 我怕它会再次发生……

lines.en: : Afraid that...{i}what{/i} might happen again?
lines.zh: : 怕……{i}什么{/i}会再次发生？

lines.en: scene utadownbad39
: You mind just giving me a minute to catch my breath and...not make any more impulsive decisions? Cause I’ve only made one so far and even that’s got the potential to flip my life on its head.
lines.zh: : 你能不能让我先喘口气、别再做出任何冲动的决定？因为我目前只做了一个，而就连这一个都有可能把我的人生彻底掀个底朝天。

lines.en: : I still think you might be overthinking this. I’m pretty sure Io will understand.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得你可能想太多了。我很确定 Io 会理解的。

lines.en: : I might be using the word wrong, but I’m pretty sure that would be ironic.
lines.zh: : 我可能用错词了，但我很确定那应该叫讽刺。

lines.en: : How come?
lines.zh: : 怎么说？

lines.en: : Because my history of {i}not{/i} thinking about things is the only reason I ever met Io in the first place.
lines.zh: : 因为正是我这{i}不{/i}爱想事情的毛病，才让我当初遇见了 Io。

lines.en: scene black
When we leave the tea ceremony room, we find Io crouched over the body of a dead caterpillar- slowly allowing dirt to sift through her fingers and cover it up.
lines.zh: 我们走出茶室时，发现 Io 正蹲在一只死掉的毛毛虫尸体前——慢慢地让泥土从指缝间漏下，把它盖起来。

lines.en: She hosts a makeshift funeral for the bug with Uta and I as guests...and doesn’t once question where we disappeared to.
lines.zh: 她为这只虫子办了一场临时葬礼，Uta 和我作为宾客出席……而她一次都没问我们刚才消失去了哪儿。

lines.en: She’s too happy to have us back.
lines.zh: 她太高兴我们回来了。

lines.en: $ utaarchery1 = True
$ uta_love += 1
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
